nodes.description: address public owner; set to msg.sender in Owned constructor, used by onlyOwner guard
address public newOwner; pending owner stored by transferOwnership and consumed by acceptOwnership
mapping(address => uint) balances; token ledger read/written by transfer, transferFrom, balanceOf and totalSupply
mapping(address => mapping(address => uint)) allowed; ERC20 allowance ledger
uint public _totalSupply; fixed supply set once in constructor
string public symbol; token ticker set in constructor
string public name; token name set in constructor
uint8 public decimals; token precision set in constructor
msg.sender; caller-controlled address used for ownership, balance indexing and allowance keys
Owned() constructor: assigns owner = msg.sender
transferOwnership(address _newOwner) public onlyOwner; sets newOwner
acceptOwnership() public; requires msg.sender == newOwner then finalizes ownership
EVATOKEN() constructor: sets metadata, mints total supply to a fixed address and emits Transfer
totalSupply() public constant returns (uint); returns _totalSupply - balances[address(0)] with raw subtraction
balanceOf(address tokenOwner) public constant; returns balances[tokenOwner]
transfer(address to, uint tokens) public; moves tokens from msg.sender using safeSub/safeAdd
approve(address spender, uint tokens) public; writes allowed[msg.sender][spender]
transferFrom(address from, address to, uint tokens) public; debits balances/allowed and credits recipient
allowance(address tokenOwner, address spender) public constant; returns allowed mapping value
approveAndCall(address spender, uint tokens, bytes data) public; approves then calls untrusted spender contract
function () public payable { revert(); } rejects plain ETH transfers
transferAnyERC20Token(address tokenAddress, uint tokens) public onlyOwner; calls arbitrary token contract transfer
SafeMath.safeAdd(uint a, uint b) public pure; overflow-checked addition
SafeMath.safeSub(uint a, uint b) public pure; underflow-checked subtraction
SafeMath.safeMul(uint a, uint b) public pure; overflow-checked multiplication
SafeMath.safeDiv(uint a, uint b) public pure; division with zero check
